name: @batonlink/codex

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Inspect a window of the current session to choose what to hand off. Read-only. Returns { total, publishableEnd, window:{from,to}, hasEarlier, messages:[{index, role, gist, publishNoise?}] }. `index` is a stable absolute position in the full session and never changes with includeTools or paging; adjacent items may skip numbers where messages are hidden. A publish range is an inclusive span over absolute indices and covers every message between its endpoints, including hidden ones. Rows marked publishNoise: true are publish machinery (batonlink tool chatter and baton-URL replies from publish rounds); default publishes exclude them. A natural-language publish request is never marked as publishNoise. Defaults to the most recent messages up to publishableEnd — the boundary before the current publish's machinery — so work done in the same turn as the request stays in view (a bare request with no other work sits after the boundary and is excluded); page earlier by passing beforeIndex = the window's `from`. gists are truncated previews; the published transcript stays verbatim.

beforeIndex.description: Exclusive upper bound: return only messages with index < beforeIndex. Omit to start at the current publish turn; pass the previous window.from to page earlier.

includeTools.description: Include tool-call and tool-result rows (default false: only user/assistant messages).

tools.name: publish_baton
tools.description: Publish selected session ranges as a Batonlink baton and return a shareable URL. Omit ranges to publish everything up to publishableEnd (excludes the current publish's tool chatter and publish machinery from earlier rounds; work done in the same turn as the request is kept). Call list_messages first when the user wants a specific slice.

title.description: Short preview title for the baton (max 200 chars). A label only — lists, share cards, page heading; put the full purpose and instructions in body.

body.description: The brief as markdown: the full purpose, key context, decisions, and recommended next steps for the receiving agent. Do not open it with an H1 that repeats title — the baton page already renders title as the heading; start with the substance.

ranges.description: 1-based inclusive range objects from list_messages, e.g. [{ start: 1, end: 5 }]. Omit (or pass []) to publish everything up to publishableEnd (the boundary before the current publish's machinery; same-turn work is kept, a bare request line is not), minus publish machinery (rows marked publishNoise in list_messages).

references.description: Optional external HTTPS links to attach as provenance (e.g. a PR, issue, doc, or dashboard), each an object { url, title?, description? }. The service stores them verbatim and never fetches or hosts them. Omit when there is nothing to link.

url.description: The reference's absolute HTTPS URL (required; must start with https://).

title.description: Optional short label for the link.

description.description: Optional one-line note on what the link is.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to Batonlink explicitly. Runs the browser device flow: a browser opens with a pre-filled approval page and the user approves in the Batonlink dashboard; the API key is saved locally and never appears in the conversation. Blocks until approved, cancelled, or expired. If no browser can open (headless), the user should set BATONLINK_API_KEY instead. Note: publish_baton pairs automatically on first use, so call this only when the user explicitly asks to log in / re-login, or after an invalid-key error.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Remove the locally saved Batonlink API key. Server-side revocation happens in the Batonlink dashboard, not here.

instructions:
Preview a window of the session to choose publish ranges
Publish selected session ranges as a shareable Batonlink baton URL
